description: This Java class defines a custom JSP tag 'ProductImageUrlTag' that generates product image URLs dynamically based on store configuration and product details. It retrieves necessary attributes from the HTTP request and session, constructs the URL, and writes it output within JSP pages.

classes.name: ProductImageUrlTag
classes.description: A custom JSP tag support class that generates product image URLs based on current store and product context.

methods.name: doStartTag
methods.description: Generates the product image URL based on the request's store configuration and product details, and writes it to the output stream.

methods.name: doEndTag
methods.description: Ends the tag processing, allowing the rest of the page to continue rendering.

methods.name: setImageName
methods.description: Sets the image name for the product image URL.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Associates a Product object with the tag.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the Product object associated with the tag.
